apps/cli/src/main.ts: CLI process entry: runs the command program once with runPromiseExit and maps the exit to the process exit code.
apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts: Electron main entry: app lifecycle events and IPC handlers are Promise callbacks that run desktop effects on the desktop ManagedRuntime; the shutdown sequence also runs the updater's install-rejection record directly, because it runs after that runtime is disposed.
apps/runtime/src/app/http-server.ts: HTTP/WebSocket boundary: makes the server-scoped RouteRuntime (FiberSet.runtimePromise/runtime over the request FiberSet) that Fastify callbacks run through.
apps/runtime/src/app/run-main.ts: Runtime process entry primitive: builds runMain on the stable Runtime.makeRunMain (plan R1, critique C1).
apps/runtime/src/index.ts: Runtime process entry: runMain runs the main layer once and owns signals and the exit code (plan R1).
apps/runtime/src/platform/http/route-run: HTTP/WebSocket boundary: the one place a Fastify request or socket callback becomes a fiber on the server request runtime (RouteRuntime.runPromise in runRouteRequest; RouteRuntime.runFork for the post-200 content-stream failure log).
apps/runtime/src/pty-processes/stream-ro: PTY WebSocket boundary: forks one scoped connection fiber per socket on the RouteRuntime.
apps/runtime/src/runtime-events/api.ts: Runtime-events WebSocket boundary: forks one scoped connection fiber per socket on the RouteRuntime.
apps/runtime/src/workflows/engine/author: Workflow SDK Promise bridge: the only Effect -> Promise conversion for author code, through an engine-scoped FiberSet.runtimePromise (plan R13).
apps/runtime/src/workflows/engine/servic: Workflow engine work set: rt.kick/rt.fork keep synchronous signatures (called from sync code inside commit) and fork onto the engine-scoped FiberSet via FiberSet.runtime (arch section 3.9).
apps/web/src/lib/state/registry.ts: Web boundary: AtomRegistry.make creates the one app registry whose atom runtime runs every web effect (plan R12).
apps/web/src/lib/state/runtime.ts: Web boundary: runApp/forkApp run app effects against the registry app runtime (plan R12).
scripts/dev-supervisor/controller.mjs: Script entry: the dev-supervisor controller process runs its program once.
scripts/dev-supervisor/signal-fixture.mj: Script entry: test fixture process that supervises children for the signal-handling tests.
scripts/sync-package-versions.mjs: Script entry: runs the version-sync CLI program once.
scripts/verify-package-versions.mjs: Script entry: runs the version-verify CLI program once.
